regime_context: The detector shows a broad but shallow leadership state: Oil & Gas Producers is a crowded, mixed-Hurst leader with high breadth, while Big Banks is a clean-trend challenger and the absolute-trend gate is validated for risk control on this market (gate_helps true). Eligible themes cover half the universe, so there is no one-narrative compression, but momentum rank itself carries no return-forecast edge — only the trend gate's drawdown discipline validates.
emerging_watch: Watching whether Big Banks' durability_bar (0.71) and trend Hurst tag can hold while Oil & Gas' mixed Hurst and crowded flag wobble. Condition to retire the watch: Banks close the rotational margin to the leader below 0.5 for five consecutive sessions without Oil & Gas regaining its breadth.

theses.subject: Oil & Gas Producers
theses.thesis: Highest cross-sectional momentum rank (2.24) with eligible trend-gate status and very high breadth (0.929), meaning the absolute-trend discipline is engaged and participation is broad. Crowding (z=1.18, crowded true) is a size-down caution only, not a fade. Mixed Hurst tag means the trend is uneven, so conviction stays low.
evidence: crowded true (reflexivity guardrail: cap, do not fade)
theses.dissent: Crowding at z=1.18 and a mixed Hurst tag mean the rally is contested and extended; energy leadership often reverses sharply when broad participation thins, and the leading theme has no return-forecast edge.

falsifier.text: XEG.TO falls below its trailing 50-day average AND breadth drops below 0.6 before the 20-trading-day check-by.

theses.subject: Big Banks
theses.thesis: Cleanest trending profile among eligible themes: hurst_tag trend, durability_bar 0.71 (highest among non-energy eligible), breadth 0.857, and not crowded (z=0.44). The rotational challenger position (score 0.847) and broad rotation view make it a durable leader candidate, though the large margin to Oil & Gas (1.393) means no confirmed handoff yet.
theses.dissent: Relative momentum is a focus lens with ~0 rank-IC; the rotational margin to the leader is wide, and a crowded energy complex can keep capital pinned in Oil & Gas rather than rotating to Financials.

falsifier.text: ZEB.TO underperforms the S&P/TSX by 3% before the 20-trading-day check-by.

theses.subject: Technology
theses.thesis: Detector flags Technology as crowded (z=1.35, highest among scorable themes) with negative momentum score (-0.03) despite a trend Hurst tag. The crowding flag is a size-down caution, not a short, but combined with negative rank and the guardrail against treating attention spikes as buys, an avoid lean is warranted.
theses.dissent: Avoiding a trend-tagged theme with adequate durability in a broad rotation environment risks missing a re-acceleration if AI/tech macro narratives reconnect with Canadian tech proxies.

falsifier.text: XIT.TO posts positive 10-day relative momentum vs SPY and crowding_z drops below 0.8 before the check-by date.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
